#define MAX_CAP_NUM 16
#define ARRAY_LEN 9


struct threeA_info_t {
    struct ae_result_info ae_info;
    struct awb_result_info awb_info;
    struct lsc_result_info lsc_info;
    struct af_result_info af_info;
    struct blc_result_info blc_info;
};

    cmr_u32 reserve24;
    cmr_u32 reserve25;

struct monitor_info {
    struct ctrl_size win_size;
    struct ctrl_size win_num;
    struct ctrl_trim trim;
};

struct ctrl_size {
    cmr_u32 w;
    cmr_u32 h;
};

struct ctrl_trim {
    cmr_u32 x;
    cmr_u32 y;
    cmr_u32 w;
    cmr_u32 h;
};

struct awb_result_info {
    cmr_u32 r_gain;
    cmr_u32 g_gain;
    cmr_u32 b_gain;
    cmr_u32 ct;
    cmr_u32 ccm[ARRAY_LEN];    //需要注意
    cmr_u32 reserve0;
    cmr_u32 reserve1;
    cmr_u32 reserve2;
    cmr_u32 reserve3[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    cmr_u32 reserve4[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve5;
    float reserve6;
    float reserve7;
    float reserve8[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};

struct lsc_result_info {
    cmr_u32 full_size_width;
    cmr_u32 full_size_height;
    cmr_u32 full_size_grid;
    cmr_u32 full_size_grid_x;
    cmr_u32 full_size_grid_y;
    cmr_u32 LSC_SPD_VERSION;
    cmr_u32 zsl_flag;
    cmr_u32 lsc_gain_w;
    cmr_u32 lsc_gain_h;
    struct ctrl_size src_size;
    struct ctrl_size prv_size;
    struct sensor_crop_info_t sns_crop_info;
    cmr_u32 reserve0;
    cmr_u32 reserve1;
    cmr_u32 reserve2;
    cmr_u32 reserve3[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    cmr_u32 reserve4[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve5;
    float reserve6;
    float reserve7;
    float reserve8[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};

struct rgb_gain_info {
	cmr_u32 bypass;
	cmr_u32 global_gain;
	cmr_u32 r_gain;
	cmr_u32 g_gain;
	cmr_u32 b_gain;
	cmr_u32 frame_id;
};

struct sensor_crop_info_t {
    cmr_u32 ae_update;
    cmr_u32 lsc_update;
    cmr_u32 full_image_width;
    cmr_u32 full_image_height;
    cmr_u32 binning;  //Nin1, N=1,2,3...
    cmr_u32 crop;    //crop:1, no_crop:0
    cmr_u32 crop_start_col;
    cmr_u32 crop_start_row;
};

struct af_result_info {
    struct af_roi af_roi_regoin;
    struct af_roi af_roi_regoin_cap;
    uint32_t af_pos;
    cmr_u32 focus_complete_flag;
    cmr_u32 reserve1;
    cmr_u32 reserve2;
    cmr_u32 reserve3[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    cmr_u32 reserve4[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve5;
    float reserve6;
    float reserve7;
    float reserve8[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};

struct af_roi {
    cmr_u32 sx;
    cmr_u32 sy;
    cmr_u32 ex;
    cmr_u32 ey;
};

struct blc_result_info {
    uint32_t r;
    uint32_t b;
    uint32_t gr;
    uint32_t gb;
    uint32_t reserve0;
    uint32_t reserve1;
    uint32_t reserve2;
    uint32_t reserve3[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    uint32_t reserve4[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve5;
    float reserve6;
    float reserve7;
    float reserve8[MAX_CAP_NUM];
    float reserve9[MAX_CAP_NUM];
};
